name: Chromaturgy (Drafting)
laws: Drafters pull luxin from light of their accessible color(s)
Each color of luxin has distinct physical properties (sub-red burns, blue is brittle, green is flexible, etc.)
Emotion tied to color — green emotions draft green luxin
A drafter's halo (ring in the iris) tracks their approach to breaking
costs: Drafting shortens the drafter's life — each use pushes the halo closer to breaking
Breaking the halo = madness (Color Wights) or death
Color-blindness takes specific colors off the table permanently
Some colors are harder on the body than others
limits: Cannot draft colors outside your spectrum
Rare few (Prisms) can draft all seven
Older drafters risk breaking every use
examples: Kip's late-game Nine King's Letters drafting

name: Ka'kari Artifact Magic
laws: Each ka'kari has specific elemental affinity and capability
The Black ka'kari devours other ka'kari
costs: Each ka'kari reshapes the user over time
The Black isolates and drives toward kill-craft
limits: Only one user per ka'kari at a time
Cannot undo the Black's consumption of other ka'kari
examples: Kylar's bond with the Black ka'kari
